thread.title: UPDATE: Justice Department looking into whether AT&T, Verizon are hampering switching carriers: report

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Justice Department looking into whether AT&T, Verizon are hampering switching carriers: report
text:
The Justice Department has opened an antitrust investigation into AT&T (T), Verizon Communications (VZ) and a telecommunications standards organization, the GSMA, over whether they hindered consumers from easily switching wireless carriers, The New York Times reported (https://www.nytimes.com/2018/04/20/technology/att-verizon-investigate-esim.html), citing six people with knowledge of the inquiry. The report said the government was looking into whether they thwarted a new technology that would allow people to switch providers without having to insert a new SIM card into a device. The report said device makers including Apple (AAPL), Google (GOOGL) and Microsoft (MSFT) support the technology.
-Steve Goldstein; 20-18 1845ET
